items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: to do a special show for General Eisenhower.

ctx.x: So then we left Tokyo, and went to Kyoto, southern Japan, all the way down to Kyoto. We caught that fast train. The train at that time wasn't as fast as the modern trains they have now. But it was one of those kind of trains that never was off time. It always was on time. Kyoto, Japan, was a shrine city. They picked our band to appear at a theater

to do a special show for General Eisenhower. They picked our unit, -- Unit Able One was our unit. And we played this theater. And whether the General came that night, I don't know. But we played this theater in Kyoto, and we were billeted at the Kyoto Hotel and a little adjoining hotel next to it. Beautiful shrine city.
